unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U18: Identify settlement-award effect, consent and failed-negotiation outcomes

payload.title: Record the agreement that supports the award
payload.core_explanation_md:
An ordinary Lok Adalat award rests on the actual compromise or settlement. The stated statutory effect treats it as a civil decree, final and binding on the parties, with no ordinary appeal under that framework. A draft offer or bank-only approval is not the same as an agreed award. Preserve the parties consent and the exact recorded terms.

The applicable court-fee refund is another consequence with its own conditions. Do not promise unrestricted reopening merely because a party later regrets the terms, or confuse absence of an ordinary appeal with a conclusion about every exceptional constitutional or fraud-related remedy. Those issues need independent legal review.

self_check.prompt_text: Is a bank-only approved offer already a binding settlement award?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The actual compromise and award record must be established.

payload.stem_md: The bank approves a proposal internally, but the other party has not agreed and no award exists. What is the correct status?

options.explanation_md: Internal approval is not the parties compromise or an award.

options.text_md: A proposal awaiting the required agreement and award process
options.explanation_md: Each legal event needs its own evidence.

options.text_md: An ordinary appeal has already been dismissed

payload.correct_explanation_md: Each legal event needs its own evidence.

payload.stem_md: A signed settlement award is described as merely an informal meeting note with no statutory effect. Which feature should be checked?

options.explanation_md: Location alone does not establish award effect.

options.text_md: Whether the bank printed it in colour
options.explanation_md: Print style is irrelevant to statutory status.
Later preference does not define the recorded award.

options.text_md: The statutory decree/finality effect of the actual award
options.explanation_md: The legal framework gives a qualifying award more than informal-note status.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal framework gives a qualifying award more than informal-note status.
